ENGLISH LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.

2. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.

3. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only an action
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a joining word

4. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

6. When practising Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening.

7. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library?

9. When practising Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

10. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. goed

11. When practising Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. No full stops
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

13. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.

14. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.

15. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. quickly

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Adjectives and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
